summary: Synthetic CRITICAL vulnerability in pdos-vuln-fixture 1.0.0 (test fixture).
details: Deterministic, hermetic OSV advisory used only by the pyforge-warden (Warden) test suite. It affects the synthetic PyPI package `pdos-vuln-fixture` at the single explicit version 1.0.0. There is no such real package; the record exists so the offline osv-scanner proof test (Story 1.4) can detect a seeded advisory with zero network and version-exact matching that never depends on real-world PyPI state. Fixed version 2.0.0 is deliberately clean.
